scope: MLP1 only; conditional implications, not exclusive labels or proof of optimizer causes

hypotheses.name: Mostly amplitude loss under distributed constructive accumulation
hypotheses.signature: Frozen scalar improves local error, natural retention and finite predicted-change fidelity across tasks/sites.
hypotheses.limitation: Improvement does not establish exact redundancy; compare absolute errors and full controls.

hypotheses.name: Substitution preserves common background better than task-changing computation
hypotheses.signature: Natural/intact behavior improves but native-background predicted-change errors remain large or worsen.
hypotheses.limitation: Would motivate separating mean/background features from task-conditioned operator directions; no semantic-unit claim from geometry alone.

hypotheses.name: Background incompatibility dominates
hypotheses.signature: Predicted changes behave better on native backgrounds than reconstructed backgrounds; native changes on reconstructed backgrounds also expose sensitivity.
hypotheses.limitation: The three response-error scalars do not form an additive attribution; compare actual response vectors and centering.

hypotheses.name: Local Euclidean fidelity misses downstream-sensitive directions
hypotheses.signature: Local-error improvement systematically disagrees with KL or causal-response improvements.
hypotheses.limitation: Cannot alone distinguish downstream Jacobian anisotropy from finite nonlinear effects or data coverage.

hypotheses.name: Output projection concentrates substitutable components but discards useful behavior
hypotheses.signature: Half-product errors are smaller geometrically inside learned spans, yet their full controls already have behavioral/causal deficits; quantify half-minus-full within each space.
hypotheses.limitation: Do not compare projected and native raw causal scores as if full references were equally faithful.

hypotheses.name: Training scalar transfer is task/site dependent
hypotheses.signature: Natural local transfer holds but task families, source/final positions or model seeds show inconsistent causal effects.
hypotheses.limitation: Do not select favorable families or use their outcomes to refit scales.

decision_rules: Report all51 raw/scaled comparisons and17full references; native and projected scopes separate.
Use fixed five-family contrast-qualified subset alongside allseven whole-task families, retaining weak/ineligible cases.
Report equal-family and pooled response errors, task accuracy, natural KL/CE and local errors separately.
Response error1 is the zero-response baseline, not a fidelity acceptance threshold. No percent-understood score.
When experiments complete, synthesize what is supported/contradicted/unresolved before any new task, product dictionary, or featurizer training.
Prefer the next test that distinguishes remaining explanations; do not repeat local subset/scale tuning.
